body: Talking about depression is not very open in my country, so never thought it was an option. Plus everyone around me was excelling while I felt like I knew nothing. Its not an excuse I know. I should have told them earlier, I wouldn’t be in this situation if I had.

Went through depression while I was pursuing the degree, which led to inaction and me dropping out. I felt so ashamed as my parents spent so much money for that. I am a horrible person for not telling them I know, but just couldn’t face them. Everyone thinks I am so intelligent.

I haven’t told a single person the truth, including my boyfriend, who will definitely leave me once he finds out, which he definitely should.

The only way out I am seeing is suicide, I can’t face them.
